notes: Coverage: the 500 four-year institutions with the largest FREOPP program coverage that clear the editorial gates (real FREOPP earnings, >= 3 reported programs, hand-verified exclusions, positive 30-year NPV at resident pricing). Absence from this list is a coverage statement, not a verdict.
